do_nothing: The 67M itself (a zero-step fine-tune) has gap 0 < floor_gap: no reading, so it is never 'reached' and can make neither (a) nor (b) hold or fail. The leftover share is computed only after the floor check, so the zero denominator is never formed.

a.claim: G rises as 1 - tv_to_F/gap rises, and passes the re-weighted cut-off 0.7943 once the leftover is under about 0.1 of the gap.
a.terms: Per seed, the scored state is step 3000. It has a reading if gap >= floor_gap. It is reached if also tv_to_F <= leftover_share x gap (read half, E139's distances). best G = the highest read G over 4 sites x 3 starts at k = 4 (E139's rule). in2 G = the highest of the 3 starts at in2, read at steps 300, 1000 and 3000.
a.rule: Holds if at least 2 seeds are reached and, on at least 2 reached seeds, best G >= cutoffs.G AND in2 G at step 3000 exceeds in2 G at step 300 by more than `rise`. FAILS if at least 2 seeds are reached and best G < cutoffs.G on at least 2 reached seeds: then the leftover was not the cause of the low G, and E139's reading of the Always on imitators stands as filed. Otherwise (fewer than 2 seeds reached; or the cut-off passed without the rise; or a split) no call, reported as read; a no call does not open a further amendment.
a.edge_cases: Values exactly at a cut-off or at leftover_share count as at or above / reached. With 3 seeds the hold and fail branches cannot both be met (each needs 2 reached seeds on its side of the cut-off; 2 + 2 > 3); 2 reached seeds split one each way is no call. If tv_to_F at step 3000 is not below that at step 300, the rise is not read (no call on the rise). By the triangle inequality the witness alone bounds G_witness >= 1 - (0.0114 + tv_to_F)/gap, about 0.82 at a reached state with gap near 0.15; so a reached seed whose best G is under 0.7943 while its witness reads above it is a search limit, reported as such.
a.blind_to: G reads outputs: a fine-tune that matches the pair closely must read near the pair's G whatever is inside it (E139 blind_to); (a) passing therefore says the low E139 G came from the leftover, not that the fine-tune reuses the pair's variable.

b.claim: The reversion at in2 stays low, near 0.2, even at the reached states.
b.rule: At step 3000, on reached seeds with a reading: the reversion of the in2 start with the highest G. Holds if it is below reversion_mid on at least 2 reached seeds; fails if at or above it on at least 2 reached seeds; fewer than 2 reached seeds: no call, values reported.
b.edge_cases: A value exactly at reversion_mid counts as at or above (fails side). Reversion can be negative (E139 out3/s2 read -0.012); that counts as below.
b.blind_to: Reversion swaps only phi's 4 coordinates at the last position; a fine-tune that carries the change in other coordinates or other positions reads low reversion whatever its route.

label.claim: Descriptive: the step-3000 states get E139's label by the filed rule (best G and best H against the cut-offs); reported, not a prediction.

reported: Per seed and step (300, 1000, 3000): gap, tv_to_F, 1 - tv_to_F/gap, best G (step 3000) and in2 G, H at five sites, reversion and mismatch at the best G site and at each H site, and E137's witness G, reversion and mismatch.
noise_floor: One start's G at the best site: 0.113 pooled (E137). Seed-to-seed spread of E139's Always on best G: 0.011; of best H: 0.055.
